title: Extract fieldwork::webfinger module
description:
WebFinger server endpoint (RFC 7033). ~70 lines, 95%+ identical across gaja/smallhold/broadside.

Source: Any (all three are nearly identical). BS server.rs:250-319, GJ discovery.rs, SH discovery.rs.

Public API:
- WebFingerResponse struct (JRD+JSON with links array)
- JrdLink struct (rel, type, href)
- parse_webfinger_resource(query: &str) -> Result<(user, domain), Error> — parse acct: URI
- build_webfinger_response(username: &str, domain: &str) -> WebFingerResponse — construct JRD with AP actor link
- Optional: axum handler that wires parse + DB lookup + build

What stays in consumers: DB lookup for user existence, route registration.

Deps: serde, serde_json. Optional: axum (for handler).

Security: Must validate domain matches server domain (prevent cross-domain WebFinger). Must reject queries without acct: prefix.
close_reason: All 7 modules extracted, 134 tests pass with full+db-sqlite features.
